audit.whatIsWrong: Three rows contradicted their own whys in both layers. Row 1 read Pantheon while its why says 'Level 2 stays even as neither side has a decisive trade yet'. Row 3 read Skill while its why says 'your Q and E sustained damage beats his cooldown-reliant burst'. Row 6 read Pantheon while its why says 'Pantheon falls off while you scale, so extended fights and duels even back out'.
audit.why: Pantheon's whole lane is levels 3 and the first-item lethality window; level 2 is one Comet Spear, levels 4-5 is where a sustain bruiser catches up, and late he falls off. The packet chart reads Skill / Skill / Pantheon / Zaahen / Skill / Pantheon / Skill and the mirror audit made no chart change to conflict with.
audit.corrected: Row 1 Pantheon->Skill, row 3 Skill->Zaahen, row 6 Pantheon->Skill, all as matched full/content pairs in one group. Rows 2 and 5 stay Pantheon.

audit.whatIsWrong: Grand Starfall's cooldown and range were never given, so 'his roam threat is high' had nothing behind it.
audit.why: Grand Starfall is 180/165/150 across 5500 range. At 180s it is by far the longest cooldown in the lane — when he spends it bot side, the side lane is free, which is the actionable half of the roam threat and was missing.
audit.corrected: spikes[2] and late rewritten with the 180s and 5500 range, and the instruction to force the side lane once it is spent.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault appeared nowhere in the writable text, and 'E Golden Onslaught' is not one of Zaahen's abilities. Shield Vault's auto-attack reset was also unmentioned.
audit.why: Aegis Assault is the single biggest ability interaction in this matchup: Riot's text says he becomes invulnerable to damage FROM THE FRONT, and it is a channel. Zaahen carries two displacements — the Q recast knockup and the W pull at 850 range — either of which ends the channel, and at 22s at rank 1 it is the longest non-ultimate window in the lane. Shield Vault also resets his auto, so the wind-up rather than the cast is the step-back cue.
audit.corrected: Aegis Assault's front-only invulnerability, channel and 22s cooldown written into spikes[1], mid, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t; Shield Vault's 13s and auto-reset into spikes[0], dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d; fabricated E name replaced with a slot reference.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'; sequencingCues was 0.
audit.why: Comet Spear 11/10.25/9.5/8.75/8, Shield Vault 13/12/11/10/9, Aegis Assault 22/21/20/19/18, Grand Starfall 180/165/150. The 22s on Aegis Assault is the concrete 'wait for X before you Y'.
audit.corrected: Numbers and explicit sequencing added across breakdown.cooldowns, spikes[0], spikes[1], mid, wants.you[0] and report[5].t.

edits.before: Pantheon spikes at 3 with his full Comet Spear poke plus Shield Vault stun; he can burst you down in a short all-in before you ramp, so respect the point-and-click stun and don't trade into a full Q-W-E combo early.
edits.after: Pantheon spikes at 3 with Comet Spear poke plus the Shield Vault stun — 13s at rank 1, and it resets his auto, so his wind-up is your cue to step back, not the cast. Do not trade into a full Q-W-E before you ramp.

edits.before: Around 4-5 you catch up: with Q Darkin Glaive and E Golden Onslaught your sustained damage out-lasts his cooldown-reliant burst, so once his Comet Spear and Shield Vault are down you win the extended trade.
edits.after: Around 4-5 you catch up: your Q and E out-last his cooldown-reliant burst. Aegis Assault blocks damage only from the front and is a channel — your W pull or Q knockup breaks it, and 22s at rank 1 is a long window without it.

edits.before: Pantheon's early lethality build lets him keep bursting you at first item, and his roam threat with R Grand Starfall is high; play safe on his spike and don't get caught out of position when his combo is up.
edits.after: Pantheon's lethality build keeps his burst live at first item, and Grand Starfall (R) is 180s at rank 1 across 5500 range — when he spends it elsewhere on the map, force the side lane instead of hiding from it.

edits.before: At level 3 Pantheon spikes hard: his full combo can burst you before you ramp, so respect the stun and trade only when his cooldowns are down. By levels 4-5 you flip it, as your Q and E Golden Onslaught sustained damage beats his cooldown-gated burst in an extended fight.
edits.after: At level 3 Pantheon spikes hard: his full combo can burst you before you ramp, so respect the 13s stun and trade only once his cooldowns are down. By levels 4-5 you flip it — your Q and E out-last his cooldown-gated burst, and any displacement you land cancels the Aegis Assault channel.

edits.before: Pantheon's first-item lethality spike and R Grand Starfall roam keep him dangerous, but as he falls off and you scale, late fights even back out; wait out his combo and your sustained damage wins the long trade.
edits.after: Pantheon's first-item lethality spike and the 180s Grand Starfall keep him dangerous, but as he falls off and you scale, late fights even back out; wait out his combo and your sustained damage wins the long trade.

edits.before: Wait out his Comet Spear and Shield Vault cooldowns
edits.after: Wait out Shield Vault's 13s before you step up

edits.before: - Pantheon Shield Vault: matchup-defining — His all-in start. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Shield Vault (W): matchup-defining — 13s at rank 1, a targeted stun that resets his auto. - Aegis Assault (E): a 22s channel that blocks the front only — any displacement cancels it. - Grand Starfall (R): 180s.

edits.before: His all-in start. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His all-in start, 13s at rank 1 — engage only once it is spent.

edits.after: His targeted stun opens the all-in — never sit low inside 600 range.

edits.after: Shield Vault is a 13s targeted stun; Aegis Assault blocks the front only and any CC cancels it.
